Metadata.title: Animal Corporation | Web UI & Experience Design
Metadata.description: A small design and technology studio creating web interfaces and experiences. We design, develop, and refine user-focused websites and web app interfaces.

About.label: About Us
About.leadSecond: we create better experiences and a better future.
About.description: Animal Corporation is a small workshop that creates web interfaces and experiences through design and technology. We design and implement solutions to fit each purpose and operation, then continuously improve quality and user experience by using and testing what we create.
About.humanCentered: We put people first and design experiences around empathy.
About.thoughtful: We thoughtfully consider each purpose and the people who will use what we create.
About.rightTechnology: We choose the right technologies for each purpose and operation.
About.simpleBeautiful: We pursue experiences that are simple, beautiful, and easy to use.

Service.label: Services
Service.introFirst: From design and implementation to quality improvement.
Service.introSecond: We focus on designing and implementing user-focused interfaces for websites and web applications.
Service.webDesign: We create clear and engaging web designs tailored to each brand and purpose.
Service.uiUxDesign: We organize information and user flows to create clear and easy-to-use experiences.
Service.webDevelopment: We choose technologies that fit each purpose and operation, focusing on interface implementation for websites and web applications.
Service.qualityImprovement: We use and test what we create to identify issues and continuously improve quality and user experience.
